---
title: "About"
subtitle: "Ecologist, LANDFIRE team"
---

I work with The Nature Conservancy's LANDFIRE team. The assessments I publish are a way into a landscape: historical ecosystems, current vegetation, and the patterns a manager can actually use.

Two examples are on this site. The [projects](projects.qmd) page charts Biophysical Settings for Monongahela National Forest. [Wooden Man Weather](https://rswaty.github.io/woodenmanweather/) is a smaller site, a weather dashboard for Marquette, Michigan.

The longer record — roles, collaborators, and the rest of the work — is on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/randyswaty/).

The painting on the [home page](index.qmd) is by Leo Barch. It was made for the Monongahela assessment.

    autoplay = TRUE,
    autoplaySpeed = 4000,
    pauseOnHover = TRUE,
    slidesToShow = 1,
    slidesToScroll = 1
  )
